bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
cd "$repo"
echo "MENU_RESIDENT_DIAG_START"
before="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
enabled="$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "RESIDENT_BEFORE=$before"
echo "RESIDENT_ENABLED=$enabled"
if test "$before" = active; then
 python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu || echo "MENU_RESIDENT_TEST_FAILED"
else
 echo "MENU_RESIDENT_TEST_BLOCKED"
fi
echo "RESIDENT_AFTER=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true)"
echo "MENU_RESIDENT_DIAG_END"
